news.text: Joining Singapore Management University in the January 2027 intake as a PhD student, advised by Prof. Zhiguang Cao (AI4Opt).
DRONEs, deep RL for k-connectivity restoration in UAV networks, appears in the SOICT 2025 proceedings (Springer CCIS).
STEAM, secure multi-connectivity for 3D wireless sensor networks, published in Computer Networks.
MERIT, multimodal retrieval over product manuals, presented at DEFI 2025 in Da Nang (first author).
Two papers on sensor-network connectivity published in the Journal of Network and Computer Applications.
